subject: Permission to publish FrontierMed quote + logo - compliance signoff
messages:
From: Jordan Ellison <j.ellison@frontiermed.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Nguyen <s.nguyen@frontiermed.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request to use quote + logo for Redwood case highlight

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last month — the team at FrontierMed is excited about the throughput improvements. We wanted to ask a quick favor: would Redwood be able to publish a short customer highlight that includes a one-sentence quote from our CTO and FrontierMed's logo?

Planned placement: a two-paragraph case highlight on Redwood’s website and a single social post. We can provide high-res logo files and a final suggested quote, but wanted to confirm any legal/comms process or restrictions on your end before we send assets.

Quick details:
- Quote (suggested): "Redwood’s inference platform reduced our inference costs by 42% while improving latency."
- Assets: will attach logos (PNG, SVG) and the CTO headshot if needed.
- Timeline: hoping to publish the week of July 18.

Are there any standard permissions or a short form you need us to sign? Let us know what you need and I’ll get it to Sarah to coordinate.

Best,
Jordan
Jordan Ellison
VP Customer Success, Frontier Medical Systems
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellison <j.ellison@frontiermed.com>
Cc: Sarah Nguyen <s.nguyen@frontiermed.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to use quote + logo for Redwood case highlight

Hi Jordan — thanks, and glad to hear the FrontierMed team is seeing value.

Looping in Marissa (Marketing) and Rishi (Legal) to confirm the approval flow. Short answers up front: we do need a signed permission for quote + logo use, and a high-res vector logo. Marissa — can you confirm the asset specs and whether we’ll request any edits to the quote? Rishi — can you advise on any must-have clauses (usage period, restrictions)?

Jordan, if you can share the SVG/logo pack and the exact wording of the quote (and who it should be attributed to), that will speed things up. We typically ask for:
- Company legal name for the credit line
- Confirmation we can use the quote in marketing materials (web + social) and in derivative materials (e.g., slide decks) for up to 12 months
- A sign-off from an authorized FrontierMed rep (we can provide a short permission PDF).

Attachments: I’ve attached our latest brand guidelines to make sure logo usage aligns with our standards.

Thanks — will try to get final signoff within 48 hours once Rishi reviews.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Communications
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_brand_guidelines_v3.pdf
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Ellison <j.ellison@frontiermed.com>, Sarah Nguyen <s.nguyen@frontiermed.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2027 13:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to use quote + logo for Redwood case highlight

Kimberly / team — I reviewed Jordan’s request. We can proceed with a standard marketing permission with the following conditions:
1) Usage limited to web, social, sales decks, and presentations (no paid ad placements without prior written consent).
2) Permission term: 12 months from signature; automatic renewal negotiable but not assumed.
3) Attribution should use Frontier Medical Systems (legal entity name). If they prefer a shortened name in the byline, we need confirmation from FrontierMed legal.
4) No edits to the substantive meaning of the quote; we may shorten for brevity if FrontierMed confirms the final truncated version.

Jordan / Sarah — I’ve attached a one-page permission template. Please have an authorized signatory review and sign. If you need us to route via DocuSign, Kimberly can send the packet.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_marketing_permission_template.pdf
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellison <j.ellison@frontiermed.com>
Cc: Sarah Nguyen <s.nguyen@frontiermed.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2027 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to use quote + logo for Redwood case highlight

Jordan / Sarah — great, thanks for the quick turnaround. Jordan attached the SVGs in a ZIP and the CTO confirmed the quote with a tiny edit (changed "42%" to "~42%" for accuracy). We accepted the minor wording change and Rishi’s conditions.

Next steps:
- I’ve prepared the DocuSign packet and sent the signature request to Sarah (link below). Once we receive the signed PDF we’ll tag the asset and schedule a draft for internal review (Marissa will circulate mockups).
- Pilot scope: web case highlight + single social post. No paid ads.
- Expected publish window: week of July 18, pending receipt of signed permission.

Link to DocuSign packet: https://app.docusign.com/secure/packet/ABC123-frontier-permission

Attaching the signed consent for records (signed by Sarah Nguyen, Director of Partnerships). Let us know if you want any copy adjustments.

Thanks again — excited to feature FrontierMed.

Kimberly Park
Head of Communications, Redwood Inference

Attachment: frontiermed_marketing_consent_signed.pdf
